Fused_Ocular_Carapace.description: A steeply domed cephalothorax plate specifically evolved to house multiple ocular nodes. It provides excellent 360-degree awareness but leaves the core ganglion somewhat exposed beneath its thinner apex.

Cheliceral_Anchorage_Skull.description: A heavily reinforced, forward-sloping skull designed entirely to anchor massive chelicerae musculature. Built for crushing bites, sacrificing sensory real estate and cognitive space for brute frontal destruction.
